claim: La Durée in Izegem held two Michelin stars but has permanently closed its doors, which is why it no longer appears as starred in the 2026 Michelin Guide Belux.
quote: Le restaurant La Durée, à Izegem, avait également deux étoiles mais a fermé ses portes.

claim: La Durée in Izegem is explicitly listed among two-star restaurants that lost their stars in the 2026 Michelin Guide Belux.
quote: Deux bi étoilés (« La Durée » à Izegem et « Ralf Berendsen » à Neerharen)

claim: Chef Angelo Rosseel announced La Durée would say farewell to Izegem, with regular service until end of March then reduced service through June before closing and selling the building.
quote: Zodra alles in kannen en kruiken is, zijn jullie de eersten die het horen ... a fresh challenge and a concept that better aligns with the current spirit of the times

claim: After leaving Izegem, La Durée now operates only as a pop-up at Café Partagé, Smedestraat 15, 8000 Brugge, open April through June, Tuesday-Friday for dinner (Saturday is NOT served), 4-course menu at €110 per person.
quote: Open april t/m juni - Dinsdag t/m Vrijdag ... 4-gangen rond de mooiste seizoensproducten ... €110 per persoon ... Café Partagé, Smedestraat 15, 8000 Brugge

claim: La Durée was chef Angelo Rosseel's restaurant at Leenstraat 28, Izegem, opened 2007, awarded 1 Michelin star in 2008 and upgraded to 2 stars in 2013; Angelo Rosseel — NOT Vincent Florizoone — has always been the chef.
quote: Chef: Angelo Rosseel ... Address: Leenstraat 28, Izegem, Belgium ... 2008: Awarded 1 star immediately after opening ... 2013: Upgraded to 2 stars

claim: Vincent Florizoone is associated with Grand Cabaret in Nieuwpoort (now reported as closed) and later worked at Brasserie Albert in Thermae Palace Oostende — he has no connection to La Durée Izegem.
quote: Nieuwpoort - chef-kok Vincent Florizoone van Grand Cabaret in Nieuwpoort

claim: La Durée Izegem's published profile lists phone +32 51 31 00 31, email resto@laduree.be, dress code Smart Casual, average all-inclusive price €255, Saturday dinner 19:00-21:00, closed Sun/Mon, no on-site accommodation; nearest hotels listed are 4-10 km away.
quote: Phone: +(0)51 31 00 31 ... Email: resto@laduree.be ... Dress Code: Smart Casual ... Average Price: €255 ... Saturday: Dinner only 19:00-21:00 ... three hotels are suggested within 4-10 km

claim: Recent diner reports at La Durée Izegem describe a Saturday-evening single 6-course menu, meal duration of about 5 hours (e.g., 8:30 PM arrival, 1:30 AM departure), champagne at €26/glass, total bill €660 for two, plus service and acoustics complaints.
quote: Between aperitif and dessert...five hours passed! ... arriving at 8:30 PM ... around 1:30 AM ... a total bill of €660 for two diners ... Champagne by the glass was noted at €26

claim: Historical opening hours of La Durée Izegem at Leenstraat 28 listed Saturday as dinner-only 18:00-21:00, with closure on Sunday and Monday and Tuesday lunch.
quote: Leenstraat 28, 8870, Izegem ... On Saturday, La Durée is open from 18:00-21:00
